Spatial prediction
W01 is a 3 m-wide observation aperture: global sill 5.20,
head 6.30, panel top 6.60. The selected standing eye ray
crosses the wall at z5.461. Crouching eye crosses below
the sill; this is a geometric prediction to test.
Follower / support
The support can stay in Laundry, but cannot shoot through
the wall beside W01. Approaching the opening is a
deliberate exposure; it is not a route or a safe
omniscient window.
Opponent / retreat
The selected ground standing ray is reciprocal and clears
the lower crest wall at y34 by about .22 m. Crouching
ground exposure and exact body slices need compiled
images; do not mistake the eye ray for full-body
visibility.
